title: LightCarbon LCG071S-PRO official package recheck
notes: The exact LCG071S-PRO page lists a LightCarbon-specific carbon fork, stem sizes 90/100/110/120 mm, SP02 seatpost by default (SP03 costs US$10 extra), and says T47 bottom brackets are paid options not included by default. It identifies China as product origin and PayPal or bank transfer as payment methods. The down-tube storage bag is optional. Headset, spacers, axles, handlebar and the full small-parts package are not itemized as included. The page gives no public price, checkout, stock, shipping, tax or returns terms.
